_meta.description: Ground truth bug annotations for benchmark evaluation
_meta.line_format: 1-indexed line numbers relative to the code block (not the CSV file)

S001.description: Multi-bug C program with memory, buffer, and logic issues

bugs.description: Returning pointer to local stack buffer — dangling pointer / undefined behavior
Off-by-one error: loop condition i <= 10 writes to scores[10], overflowing a 10-element array
strcpy of unchecked argv[1] into 16-byte dest buffer — buffer overflow
fopen return value not checked for NULL — file may not exist
fgets called with potentially NULL file pointer from unchecked fopen
Double free of scores pointer — heap corruption / undefined behavior

S002.description: Multi-vulnerability C program with security and memory issues

bugs.description: Dereference of uninitialized pointer — undefined behavior / crash
Signed integer overflow — undefined behavior in C/C++
Format string vulnerability — printf with user-controlled format string
Use-after-free — accessing memory after free(buf)
Potential null pointer dereference — ptr may be NULL if argc <= 5
SQL injection — unsanitized argv[1] passed to process_input which builds raw SQL
Memory leak — malloc'd memory never freed before return

S003.description: Concurrency, command injection, and resource management bugs

bugs.description: TOCTOU race condition — access() check then fopen() allows race window
fopen return value not checked for NULL inside safe_read_file
fgets called with potentially NULL file pointer from unchecked fopen
Dangling pointer — old pointer used after realloc may have moved the block
Command injection — unsanitized user input passed to system() via sprintf
Signed/unsigned comparison — int -1 compared with unsigned int, implicit conversion
gets() is banned — reads unbounded input into fixed 64-byte buffer
Realloc dangling pointer — use-after-realloc via grow_buffer
Calling TOCTOU-vulnerable safe_read_file with user-controlled path
File handle leak — log2 opened but never closed before return
